reserveReview.rationale: The October 27 captured Sky book (Block Analitica groups feed, 8-group census, 2026-10-27T16:15:32Z) totals $10,634,677,862.31 group debt. At Ethereum block 26285179 (2026-10-27T16:15:23Z) LitePSM gem() and pocket() return canonical USDC and the verified pocket, which holds $3,855,715,288.247954 USDC, or 36.256061% of total debt. Both DAI and USDS share this book. The measurement sits $15,941.44 below the $3,855,731,229.69 stablecoins group debt, so no excess cap applies and the 0.00015% unattributed stablecoins remainder rounds to the zero keyed residual row. Spark $3,865,739,649.40 (36.35%), Grove $1,881,439,967.11 (17.69%), Obex $405,806,827.00 (3.82%), Core $389,431,324.16 (3.66%), Staking Engine $161,101,693.80 (1.51%), Legacy RWA $70,427,132.12 (0.66%), and Osero $5,000,039.04 (0.05%) are weighted at two decimals. The zero keyed residual is a classification row, not a holding. Positive unexplained remainders and failed reconciliations retain the existing very-low PSM-pool risk, without an inferred constituent identity. Allocators remain classified at their deployed-strategy failure domain.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: October 27 captured group-debt shares; canonical gem() and measured LitePSM USDC pocket balance at Ethereum block 26285179 with explicit reconciliation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Unexplained positive PSM remainders stay unlinked; excess above 0.25 percentage points fails the split closed. Allocator groups have no invented tracked-token look-through weights.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Grove is a Sky Agent allocation into institutional-credit strategies, not a direct wrapper around one tracked stablecoin.
Spark is an allocator and lending-protocol position with multiple deployment counterparties, not a direct wrapper around one tracked stablecoin.
Obex is an Agent allocation across supported institutional stablecoin projects rather than one canonical tracked reserve asset.
The Core bucket is a multi-collateral crypto-vault pool, not one canonical tracked reserve asset.
The Staking Engine bucket is collateralized by SKY positions in LockStake Engine vaults, not by another tracked stablecoin.
The legacy RWA bucket represents external legal structures and obligors rather than a direct tracked-stablecoin dependency.
Osero is a Sky allocator position with mutable deployed strategies rather than one direct tracked-stablecoin reserve asset.
